Thanks Vivek — we can assemble a scoped packet. Plan below:

1) SCIM delta (30d) — produce scim-delta-30d-redacted.csv; will include: event timestamp, operation (create/update/delete), target resource type, and a hashed identifier for subject. No cleartext emails. EU-region slice available.

2) SAML assertion samples — saml-assertions-samples-202801.txt; will include samples for NameID formats we support (email, persistent ID) and audience/relying-party attributes; timestamps preserved, user identifiers replaced with stable pseudonyms.

3) RBAC role matrix — rbac-role-matrix.xlsx; maps internal role name -> permissions -> example resources. We'll add a short mapping to SIG/CAIQ control IDs in a final tab.

4) Service account inventory — service-account-inventory.csv; includes owner, creation date, last-used, and elevation justification.

5) Readme and transfer notes — readme-delivery-notes.txt with redaction rules, sampling percentages, and the secure-transfer URL.

Delivery approach: we will stage the files to a pre-signed EU S3 share and provide a one-time SFTP credential (FreshHealth preference). I need a confirmation on the SFTP host credential format and an exact username to provision.

Timeline: preliminary canary samples (SAML + 48 hours of SCIM slice) by Monday EOD (2028-02-13 UTC), full packet by Thursday (2028-02-16) if no blockers. If FreshHealth needs everything within 5 business days, we can prioritize and deliver the redacted packet by 2028-02-14 with partial logs omitted (to avoid extensive legal redaction).

Security notes: any logs containing EU PII will be redacted using our hash-salt process; we can provide the hash mapping under NDA if required. Also note long-lived service accounts will have justification text; we may redact internal IPs.
